SMALL CLAIMS HEARING OF OCT-09-2018 - JUDGMENT.

THE COURT HAS ORDERED THE FOLLOWING JUDGMENT ENTERED: IT IS ADJUDGED THAT PLAINTIFF FLORES, DIANA RECOVER FROM DEFENDANT BARBOSA, GUILLERMINA $600.00 PRINCIPAL, TOTAL JUDGMENT $600.00, MS. BARBOSA IS THE PROPER DEFENDANT BECAUSE SHE IS THE MASTER TENANT FOR THE ROOMS MS. FLORES AGREED TO RENT. MS. BARBOSA FAILED TO TAKE REASONABLE STEPS TO FILL THE ROOMS AFTER MS. FLORES RESCINDED HER AGREEMENT TO RENT THE ROOMS. HAD SHE TAKEN REASONABLE STEPS TO MITIGATE HER DAMAGES AS REQUIRED BY LAW, HER DAMAGES WOULD NOT HAVE EXCEEDED $400.00. STAY OF EXECUTION 30 DAYS NO EXHIBITS FILED
